{"message":"## OpenCulturas installation — SUCCESS

The OpenCulturas Drupal distribution was installed successfully using the documented DDEV-based development method.

### Method used (final, successful)
- Working directory: `/workspace` (repository checked out at commit `838d5d0`, branch detached at `3.1.x` HEAD).
- `ddev start` → started `ddev-openculturas-web`, `ddev-openculturas-db`, `ddev-router`, phpmyadmin (Drupal 11 / PHP 8.4 / MySQL 8.0).
- `ddev composer install` → installed all Composer dependencies, applied all tracked `cweagans/composer-patches` patches, scaffolded `web/`.
- `ddev composer run si` → `drush site:install --yes` (profile-based install of the `openculturas` profile). This completed with `[success] Installation complete.`

### Resulting state (verified)
- `drush core:status`: Drupal version `11.3.17`, Database `Connected`, Drupal bootstrap `Successful`, Install profile `openculturas`, Default theme `opcult`.
- 175 modules enabled.
- Homepage `http://openculturas.ddev.site/` returns HTTP 200 with `<title>Welcome | OpenCulturas</title>`; `/user/login` returns 200.
- `drush updatedb` reports "No pending updates"; `drush cache:rebuild` succeeds; one-time login link generated.
- Access point: `http://openculturas.ddev.site` (admin user `admin`, generated password `La6EbG9tzc`), or `ddev launch /admin`.

### Abandoned attempt
The guide's primary dev command `ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config` (config-sync install) failed reproducibly during config import with:
`The service "openculturas_openstreetmap.addressLookup" has a dependency on a non-existent service "geocoder.throttle".`
This is caused by `openculturas_openstreetmap` being enabled before the `geocoder` module in `config/sync/core.extension.yml`, while its `AddressLookup` service autowires `geocoder.throttle`. This is a bug in the checked-out commit's config ordering, not an environment problem. Installation was recovered using the alternative documented install path (`ddev composer run si`, profile install), which enables modules in dependency order and completed successfully.

### Additional actions performed (not in the guide)
- Installed DDEV v1.25.4 (guide assumes it is already present) by downloading the Linux tarball; DDEV refuses to run as root, so a non-root user `ddevuser` (in the `docker` group) was created and the workspace chowned to it.
- Installed the `unzip` system package (used only to inspect the upstream `drupal/openculturas_project` template; not required for the final install).
- Added `safe.directory` git config for the workspace.

### Environment
Ubuntu 22.04 in a container on WSL2; Docker Engine 29.7.2 with working daemon; PHP/Composer/MySQL provided inside DDEV containers (no host PHP/Composer).","reported_outcome":"success","installation_summary":"## OpenCulturas installation summary

**Method (final, successful):** DDEV development method from the guide/README, run in `/workspace` (repository at commit `838d5d0`, detached HEAD on `3.1.x`).

1. Installed DDEV v1.25.4 (see "Additional actions"). Created non-root user `ddevuser` (docker group) because DDEV refuses to run as root; chowned `/workspace` to it.
2. `ddev start` — created and started the project containers: `ddev-openculturas-web` (drupal11, PHP 8.4, nginx-fpm), `ddev-openculturas-db` (mysql 8.0), `ddev-openculturas-phpmyadmin`, `ddev-router`, `ddev-ssh-agent`. All reached healthy state.
3. `ddev composer install` — installed all dependencies from `composer.lock` into `/workspace/vendor` and `/workspace/web`, applied all patches tracked in `patches.lock.json`, ran scaffolding. Completed without error.
4. `ddev composer run si` — this composer script runs `rm -rf web/sites/default/files && mkdir -p .../translations` then `drush site:install --yes`, i.e. the **profile-based** install of the `openculturas` install profile. Output ended with `[success] Installation complete. (Admin)` and `[success] User name: admin  User password: La6EbG9tzc`.

**Resulting state (verified):**
- `/workspace/web` is the Drupal docroot; config sync at `/workspace/config/sync`; private files `web/sites/default/files/private`.
- `drush core:status`: Drupal `11.3.17`, Database `Connected`, bootstrap `Successful`, Install profile `openculturas`, Default theme `opcult`, admin theme `gin`.
- 175 modules enabled.
- `http://openculturas.ddev.site/` → HTTP 200, `<title>Welcome | OpenCulturas</title>`; `/user/login` → 200.
- `drush updatedb` → "No pending updates"; `drush cache:rebuild` → success; `drush user:login` produced a valid one-time login URL.
- Access point: `http://openculturas.ddev.site` (admin / La6EbG9tzc); admin UI via `ddev launch /admin`.

**Abandoned attempt:** The guide's documented dev install command `ddev drush site:install --yes --existing-config` (install from existing config) fails reproducibly during the config-import batch with `The service "openculturas_openstreetmap.addressLookup" has a dependency on a non-existent service "geocoder.throttle"`. Root cause: in `config/sync/core.extension.yml` the `openculturas_openstreetmap` module is enabled before `geocoder` (alphabetical order), yet its autowired `AddressLookup` service requires `geocoder.throttle`; the container is compiled before geocoder's services are registered. This is an ordering bug in the checked-out commit, independent of the environment. The installation was recovered via the alternative documented path (`ddev composer run si`, profile install), which enables extensions in dependency order.
